skills.title: Northern Luzon pine highlands
skills.attributionHtml:
Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

Meta taken from Learnable Landscapes by Stingray
scoringCaveats: Source-tagged regional tendency, not an exclusive boundary. Bulk source locations have not all been individually rechecked.
skills.trainingNote: Look for pine-covered mountain slopes and relatively dry highland scenery. This favors northern Luzon; rare high-altitude Mindanao scenes can resemble it.

skills.title: Mindanao albizia canopy
skills.attributionHtml:
Source: PlonkIt

Meta taken from A Major Bajor World by Major Bajor
scoringCaveats: Source-tagged regional tendency, not an exclusive boundary. Bulk source locations have not all been individually rechecked.

skills.attributionHtml:
Source: PlonkIt

skills.trainingNote: Yellow-and-black painted concrete barriers are useful in the northern Luzon highlands. Combine the construction and paint pattern with mountain scenery; yellow and black elsewhere is not enough.

skills.title: Bicol triple-black guardrail stripes
skills.attributionHtml:
Source: PlonkIt

Meta taken from A Major Bajor World by Major Bajor
scoringCaveats: Source-tagged regional tendency, not an exclusive boundary. Bulk source locations have not all been individually rechecked.
skills.trainingNote: Look for groups of three black bands on white concrete guardrails. This is a Bicol tendency; count the bands and check the barrier rather than treating any striped roadside as Bicol.

skills.title: Mindanao pineapple fields
skills.trainingNote: Low, dense rows of stiff, spiky rosettes are pineapple plants. Extensive plantations favor Mindanao, particularly its upland growing areas; the crop is not exclusive to one province.

skills.attributionHtml:

skills.attributionHtml:
